lede: The biggest thing on the calendar this week is Tuesday's Telluride Town Council meeting, where three real decisions are on the table: a cost-sharing supplement to the Gondola IGA tied to the 2027 planning budget, plus first readings of two ordinances touching the Town's Energy Mitigation Program. Over in Ouray County, commissioners are also deep in consequential territory — a fifth extension of the Emergency Disaster Declaration and preliminary discussions on merging EMS with Ridgway Fire. Closer to home, the gondola is closed for maintenance Monday, and the week winds down with the Witches Ride and Young Frankenstein to keep things from getting too serious.

notable.stake: Council votes on gondola IGA cost-sharing and two ordinances get first reading.
